An attacker can permanently prevent a lender from withdrawing their funds by repeatedly sending 0-value token transfers to the victim. This action triggers the `_afterTokenTransfer` hook, which constantly resets the victim's withdrawal delay timer. This creates a denial-of-service (DoS) vulnerability, as the victim is unable to withdraw their funds due to the constant resetting of the timer.
